name: Sheet Pan Nachos with Pinto Beans, Pickled Veggies, Sour Cream, Avocado & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 jalapeño pepper
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Place vinegar, water, sugar, and spices in a small saucepan. Stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup apple cider vinegar
⅓ cup water
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp coriander, ground
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once boiling, remove from heat. Add onion and jalapeño to the pan; stir to combine and set aside.
Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Small dice tomatoes and place in a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in another small bowl.
Arrange tortilla chips on a large baking sheet pan, spreading them out in an even layer. Top with beans and cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 oz tortilla chips
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend

instructions.primary_message: Place nachos in the oven and bake until beans are warmed through and cheese is melted, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, have and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice. Place in a third small bowl.
Divide nachos between plates and top with tomato, cilantro, avocado, pickled veggies, and sour cream as desired. Enjoy!
